stem: Without any randomisation, a new store layout shows a higher conversion rate in small, medium and large stores alike, but a lower rate overall. Small stores convert less, and most stores with the new layout are small. Which comparison should you lead with?

options.text: The overall conversion rate, because it uses all the data
The comparison within store sizes, with the size mix explained
Whichever of the two comparisons favours the new layout
Neither, because the paradox shows the numbers contain an error
